scripts.release:check: npm run build --silent && npm test --silent && npm run exports:check && npm run scan -- validate-fixtures && npm run test:live-validation-harness
scripts.test:integration:llm:api:live: npm run build --silent && node scripts/test-live-llm-integration.mjs --provider openai
scripts.e2e:audit:api:live: npm run build --silent && node scripts/e2e-live-audit.mjs --provider openai
scripts.phase3:codex:live: npm run test:integration:llm:live && npm run e2e:audit:live
scripts.phase3:api:live: npm run test:integration:llm:api:live && npm run e2e:audit:api:live
scripts.production:static-readiness: npm run build --silent && npm test --silent && npm run exports:check --silent && npm run smoke:openai-codex-oauth --silent && npm run e2e:static-pi --silent && npm run e2e:static-pi-ui --silent
scripts.production:runtime-readiness: npm run build --silent && node dist/apps/cli/src/index.js runtime-doctor --json && node dist/apps/cli/src/index.js validate-runtime-fixtures && npm run exports:check --silent
scripts.production:harness-readiness: npm run production:static-readiness && npm run production:runtime-readiness
scripts.scan:self: npm run build --silent && node dist/apps/cli/src/index.js scan path . --output ./.artifacts/runs/self-scan-ts --mode static
